region_scene_page.compact: Alternative rap grew through artists who kept hip-hop's core practices while bending its sounds toward jazz, indie, underground, absurdist, or art-school worlds.
region_scene_page.standard: Alternative rap grew through artists who kept hip-hop's core practices while bending its sounds toward jazz, indie, underground, absurdist, or art-school worlds. The Roots feat. Erykah Badu's You Got Me, Common's The Light, Madvillain's All Caps, and Kid Cudi's Day 'n' Nite give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Alternative rap grew through artists who kept hip-hop's core practices while bending its sounds toward jazz, indie, underground, absurdist, or art-school worlds. The record often sounds like a self-contained world rather than a format-ready single. The Roots feat. Erykah Badu's You Got Me, Common's The Light, Madvillain's All Caps, and Kid Cudi's Day 'n' Nite give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
